summary: Iteration 76: Brand Color Palette Update Testing - All visual tests passed. Verified the color palette update from #0F172A → #0A2A63 (navy), #0052FF → #35D6C8 (teal), #2563EB → #67E3D3 (hover teal) across landing page, auth modal, dashboard, navbar, dropdowns, and all major components. Both desktop and mobile views render correctly with the new brand colors.
critical_code_review_comments: CSS custom properties in index.css correctly define brand colors: --brand-navy: #0A2A63, --brand-teal: #35D6C8, --brand-teal-light: #67E3D3
App.js uses bg-[#0A2A63] for main dashboard background - correctly updated
Navbar.jsx uses #35D6C8 for Connect Broker button, user avatar, and various accent elements
AuthModal.jsx uses #35D6C8 for active tab and #67E3D3 for hover states
LandingPage.jsx uses Tailwind teal-400/500 classes which align with brand guide
BrokerConnect.jsx uses #35D6C8 for buttons and #67E3D3 for hover states
All dropdown menus use bg-[#0A2A63] for consistent navy background
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 76 verified the brand color palette update. Key colors: Primary navy #0A2A63, accent teal #35D6C8, hover teal #67E3D3. All 197 color references were updated via bulk sed replacement. CSS custom properties added to index.css. The visual change is subtle (navy is slightly bluer, blue accents became teal). All components tested: Landing page, Auth modal, Dashboard, Navbar, Platform/Strategies/Education/Resources dropdowns, User menu, Connect Broker modal, AI War Room, AI Intelligence Hub, Sector Heatmap, Paper Trading modal, Chat panel. Both desktop (1920x1080) and mobile (390x844) views verified.
